title: CCEP ECoG dataset across age 4-51
redistribution: CC0: the benchmark may redistribute epoched NWB files of this subset; the repository holds this index only

site_rule.order: first stimulation sites in the order of the events file with at least min_trials trials

selection: the six runs of validation/ds004080_subjects.txt (spec §7.3 rule, fixed before any result, REQ-371)

truth.rule: a contact is responsive when at least 2 of the rules detect a response, not responsive when none does; contacts where exactly one rule detects a response are not scored. The unstated fields of the rules are those of the benchmark baselines (evoparam.benchmark.baselines.RULE_OVERRIDES). T2 truth on the consensus responders: the N1 peak of vanblooijs2023.
truth.human_raters: not used: the dataset's derivatives hold no human N1 scoring (spec §7.3 asks to check; none is listed in the registry)
